_doc: Phase 83.6 RESERVED write set v6 — 300 PT/EN messages authored AFTER the Phase 83 fixes (83.1–83.5) with NEW names, places, jobs, companies, foods, drinks, teams, pets and sentence structures that none of v1–v5 used. Same schema as v1–v5 (expect = the CURRENT first-person facts the message asserts; empty for questions, third parties, hypotheticals, fiction, quotes, past, predicates, hedges; prior = messages applied first; expect_clear = slots that must be gone). Values are copied from the user's words. Sealed by commit before its single run: scripts/run_write_set.py --set scripts/oracles/write_set_v6.json. Pre-registered gate G1 (ROADMAP 83): precision >= 0.90 and coverage >= 0.75. NEVER patched against; its misses become regression cases for the next reserved set.
